title: The 12:00: a note-taker, the parking in one minute, then what Lisbon needs
detail: Two days to opening night. (1) Name a note-taker in the first minute: the 5 and 6 November 18:00s have no record. (2) Park the late, unowned issues: open since Friday, list ready (45 to park, 21 kept); Vicky and Dinis, yes or no in one line (125 late, 78 unowned). (3) Before Monday: the garment files and Jose's navy (WS-48), the outreach claim (WS-26). (4) New today: SG/Send tokens per agent for Silvio's and Jose's agents (WS-170, Dinis). (5) Then WS-09, WS-107, WS-125. 21 decisions open, 20 with Dinis. Say each as 'decided: <item>: <words>'.

closed.why: An order for the 7 November 12:00, which has passed. Its asks (a note-taker, the parking decision) carry over in their own items.
